title: Running time of the fixed-word comparator
statement: For all Boolean words $w_0,u,v$, the machine that compares its input with $w_0$ and emits $u$ on equality and $v$ otherwise computes the function $w\mapsto (u\text{ if }w=w_0\text{, and }v\text{ otherwise})$ in time $\bigl(|w_0|+\max(|u|,|v|)+3\bigr)(|w|+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: arbitrary Boolean words w₀, u, and v
